title: Approval Share on FBN Inbound-Shortage Cases by Performance Level
content:
| Seller Performance Standing level | Approval share on a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inbound-shortage case |
|---|---|
| Preferred Partner Level | full approval share, 100% (1.0) |
| Top Rated Level | full approval share, 100% (1.0) |
| Above Standard Level | not altered by this table |
| Standard Level | not altered by this table |
| Developing Seller Level | reduced approval share, 75% (0.75) |
| Below Standard Level | reduced approval share, 75% (0.75) |

**Rule.** The approval share on an inbound-shortage case is the full approval share of 100% for a seller whose performance standing level is Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level and the reduced approval share of 75% for a seller at Below Standard Level or Developing Seller Level; a seller at Standard Level or Above Standard Level is not affected by this table.

The level is the seller's current level on their Seller Performance Standing record.

Illustration (hypothetical): applied to 20 units, the full share of 100% gives 20 units and the reduced share of 75% gives 15 units.
